GTA 6 Free & Standout Vehicles

Free cars worth taking to Moses, one-of-a-kind standout vehicles and Randy’s wish list.

38 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Moses Watkins — Free First RegistrationA Port Gellhorn mechanic will put your first stolen car in your name for nothing — choose wisely. Invetero Coquette '64 (Fontana Motorsports)A dusty classic hides behind the shiny tracked sports cars at an upscale dealership. Maibatsu Penumbra FF '97 (Paul Walker Tribute)A bright green movie-famous coupe sleeps in a villa garage on an island between the city and the beach. Canis Black Moth KamachoA cartel off-roader with room for everything you own waits at a guarded bayside safehouse. Vapid Montagne XL (Moses' Offered Car)The mechanic's own tutorial SUV is parked right behind his workshop — easy, but is it worth your one freebie? Vapid Firebug DominatorA supercharged muscle car roosts at a derelict motel not far from the mechanic's shop. Declasse Ghosts Exposed ParklandA paranormal-themed classic haunts a house that celebrates Halloween all year. Bravado Bison 1800No road trip, no gunfight: the practical six-slot pickup is already parked near the mechanic. Moses' Emperor Sultan (Gift)Finish every job the mechanic asks of you and he hands over a car of his own. Declasse Vamos (Keypad Garage)One of the mechanic's shopping-list cars sleeps behind a keypad — and the code is hiding in plain sight nearby. BF Bandito (Buckskin Swamp Racer)One of the mechanic's targets never parks — it just laps a dirt loop deep in the swamp. Vapid '32 Hustler (Mission Reward)A vintage hot rod can be yours at the end of a Chapter 3 job — if you play it trusting. '70 Vapid Ganado (Jason's Starting Car)Jason's wagon is yours from the first hours — and it is the one car in the game that starts out already registered. Invetero Oubliette CoquetteSomething classic was left to rust inside a sealed shipping container. Invetero Enforcer CoquetteThe boldest steal in Leonida sits on a pedestal in front of the one building you least want to rob. Invetero Spiderweb CoquetteA party house's garage hides a web-covered classic behind a keypad — and the code is part of the decor. Progen Royal Ruby EmerusA ruby supercar worth a small house sleeps in a mansion garage on the same island as the green coupe. Bravado Devil's Rope GauntletA gang's prized Hellfire waits inside their garage — mind the dogs. Grotti '95 Cheetah (Ultimate Edition Reward)A Miami Vice icon is handed to Ultimate Edition owners late in the story — no theft required. Lapwing Stolen Valor 300-HA little military-style plane sits unlocked on a strip at the edge of the map, free for the taking. Pfister Vanessa's Growler (Free Garage Car)A lockup in the city holds a pink sports car left as a gift — and the garage itself comes with it. Randy's Wish List (Mechanic Overview)From Chapter 3, a fence at a car dealership pays supercar money for a very specific shopping list. Granforma Zorrusso (Randy's First Job)The car that teaches you to clone keys is parked in a beachside apartment car park. Pegassi Infernus (Police Garage)The hardest car on the list is parked on the roof level of a police station's own car park. Pegassi Vitello (Flamingo Parkway Villa)A wish-list supercar hides in a villa garage on a palm-lined parkway east of Belville. Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire (M7 Junkyard)A wish-list muscle car sits in a gang-run junkyard — open your escape route before you take it. Bravado Banshee (Sweetbay Inn)A wish-list Banshee checks into a Capri motel in the small hours of the night. Pegassi Tempesta (Tow Truck / Lake Cabin)This wish-list supercar may need rescuing from a tow truck before you can steal it. Pegassi Toros (Purple, Pegassi Residences)A purple wish-list supercar poses outside the entrance of its own maker's residence tower. Grotti Itali RSX (Vespucci Island Garage)Another wish-list supercar sleeps behind a wooden fence on the same island as the green coupe. Piccia Furia (Peacock Estates)A wish-list supercar waits at a mansion on a lane in the estates. Declasse Mamba GT (Leaf Links Mansion)A classic GT is locked inside a golf-course mansion — the key is hiding somewhere domestic. Invetero Coquette D10 (Wasman Island Docks)A wish-list Corvette-style coupe waits by a red shipping container at the western docks. Truffade Thrax (Wish List Final Reward)Finish the fence's whole list and the last car is a prize rather than a payment. Randy's Wish List Cars — Rich Capri House SpawnsThe richest streets in Capri randomly host the exact supercars the fence is paying fortunes for. Ascot Paragon (Wish List)A wish-list grand tourer with two reported hiding spots. Pfister Growler (Fig St Multi-Storey)A wish-list Growler sleeps in an Ocean Beach multi-storey — not the pink gift car. 1010 Cheetah (Mural Unlock)A second Cheetah hides behind a street-art hunt — reportedly.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
